# Accordion

## Accordion

Accordion stacks headed sections that open and close independently, each
with a chevron and a divider rule. Its members are AccordionItem (one
headed section, composited inside Accordion) and AccordionSkeleton (the
placeholder shape while the content loads).

### Decisions

- `requires_parent` on AccordionItem: the member reads the parent's align,
  size, flush and divider-hover context; standalone it draws one item with
  its own top rule.
- `no_reference` on AccordionItem: there is no upstream visual reference
  for the member alone; it is measured through Accordion's `default`,
  `open`, `start` and `disabled` samples.
- `control.accordion_content_end_ratio` stands in for the primary
  reference's 480/640 content end-padding steps (the compact variant is 0).
- The hover rule blends: a hovered heading's own top rule and the next
  item's rule both read `color.accordion_divider_hover`.
- AccordionSkeleton's `ordered` has no upstream propTypes entry (recorded
  in the census); the flag is still offered.

### Platform

`platform.support` is `both`: the same factory runs on web and native. The
content region mounts and unmounts with `open` (no shared motion seam is
composed here); the chevron swaps `chevron_down`/`chevron_up` over
`motion.duration_fast_02` where the host animates.

## Accordion

Accordion stacks headed sections that open and close independently, each with a chevron and a divider rule.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `disclosure`, `keyboard` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `array` | yes | The sections, each `{ title, children, open, defaultOpen, disabled, id }`  -  `open` controls, `defaultOpen` seeds uncontrolled. |
| `align` | `string` | no | Chevron side: `start` (before the title) or `end` (after). Default `end`, upstream's `align` prop. |
| `size` | `string` | no | Heading size: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. Default `md`. |
| `isFlush` | `boolean` | no | Pulls the heading text to the page edge (`control.accordion_flush_inset`). |
| `ordered` | `boolean` | no | Numbers the sections (an ordered list element instead of an unordered one). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables every section heading; an item's own `disabled` also applies. |
| `onChange` | `function` | no | Called as `{ index, open }` when a section toggles. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `dividerWidth` | `control.accordion_divider_width` |
| `flushInset` | `control.accordion_flush_inset` |
| `headingPaddingInline` | `control.accordion_heading_padding_inline` |
| `focusWidth` | `control.accordion_focus_width` |
| `iconSize` | `control.accordion_icon_size` |
| `iconTop` | `control.accordion_icon_top` |
| `titleGap` | `control.accordion_title_gap` |
| `contentPaddingTop` | `control.accordion_content_padding_top` |
| `contentPaddingBottom` | `control.accordion_content_padding_bottom` |
| `contentPaddingEnd` | `control.accordion_content_padding_end` |
| `contentEndRatio` | `control.accordion_content_end_ratio` |
| `sizeSmall` | `size.size_small` |
| `sizeMedium` | `size.size_medium` |
| `sizeLarge` | `size.size_large` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"items":[{"title":"Section 1","children":"Section one body text."},{"title":"Section 2","children":"Section two body text."},{"title":"Section 3","children":"Section three body text."}]}` |
| open | `{"items":[{"title":"Section 1","children":"Section one body text."},{"title":"Section 2","open":true,"children":"Section two body text."},{"title":"Section 3","children":"Section three body text."}]}` |
| start | `{"align":"start","items":[{"title":"Section 1","children":"Section one body text."},{"title":"Section 2","open":true,"children":"Section two body text."},{"title":"Section 3","children":"Section three body text."}]}` |
| flush | `{"isFlush":true,"items":[{"title":"Section 1","children":"Section one body text."},{"title":"Section 2","open":true,"children":"Section two body text."},{"title":"Section 3","children":"Section three body text."}]}` |
| small | `{"size":"sm","items":[{"title":"Section 1","children":"Section one body text."},{"title":"Section 2","open":true,"children":"Section two body text."},{"title":"Section 3","children":"Section three body text."}]}` |
| large | `{"size":"lg","items":[{"title":"Section 1","children":"Section one body text."},{"title":"Section 2","open":true,"children":"Section two body text."},{"title":"Section 3","children":"Section three body text."}]}` |
| disabled | `{"items":[{"title":"Section 1","disabled":true,"children":"Section one body text."},{"title":"Section 2","children":"Section two body text."},{"title":"Section 3","children":"Section three body text."}]}` |
| ordered | `{"ordered":true,"items":[{"title":"Step 1","children":"Step one body text."},{"title":"Step 2","open":true,"children":"Step two body text."},{"title":"Step 3","children":"Step three body text."}]}` |

## AccordionItem

AccordionItem is one headed section of an Accordion with its chevron, title and collapsible content; it must be composed inside Accordion and has no upstream visual reference.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `none` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `disclosure`, `keyboard` |
| Flags | `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent; `no_reference` - no upstream visual reference; gates are structural, accessibility and cross-template |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | yes | The heading text. |
| `children` | `node` | no | The collapsible body. |
| `open` | `boolean` | no | Controlled open state. Absent: the item keeps its own from `defaultOpen`. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | no | Initially open while uncontrolled. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables the heading. |
| `id` | `string` | no | Composition prop: the content element's id the heading's `aria-controls` names; a stable id is generated when absent. |
| `onOpenChange` | `function` | no | Called with the next open state. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `dividerWidth` | `control.accordion_divider_width` |
| `flushInset` | `control.accordion_flush_inset` |
| `headingPaddingInline` | `control.accordion_heading_padding_inline` |
| `focusWidth` | `control.accordion_focus_width` |
| `iconSize` | `control.accordion_icon_size` |
| `iconTop` | `control.accordion_icon_top` |
| `titleGap` | `control.accordion_title_gap` |
| `contentPaddingTop` | `control.accordion_content_padding_top` |
| `contentPaddingBottom` | `control.accordion_content_padding_bottom` |
| `contentPaddingEnd` | `control.accordion_content_padding_end` |
| `contentEndRatio` | `control.accordion_content_end_ratio` |
| `sizeSmall` | `size.size_small` |
| `sizeMedium` | `size.size_medium` |
| `sizeLarge` | `size.size_large` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| open | `{"title":"Section one","defaultOpen":true,"children":"Section one body text."}` |
| closed | `{"title":"Section one","children":"Section one body text."}` |
| disabled | `{"title":"Section one","disabled":true,"children":"Section one body text."}` |

## AccordionSkeleton

AccordionSkeleton draws the placeholder shape of an accordion, one section open, while its content loads.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `disclosure`, `keyboard` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | `number` | no | How many placeholder sections draw. Default 4. |
| `open` | `boolean` | no | Whether the first section draws its content bars. Default true. |
| `align` | `string` | no | Chevron side: `start` or `end`. Default `end`. |
| `isFlush` | `boolean` | no | Pulls the heading to the page edge. |
| `ordered` | `boolean` | no | Draws the ordered list element. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `dividerWidth` | `control.accordion_divider_width` |
| `flushInset` | `control.accordion_flush_inset` |
| `headingPaddingInline` | `control.accordion_heading_padding_inline` |
| `iconSize` | `control.accordion_icon_size` |
| `iconTop` | `control.accordion_icon_top` |
| `titleGap` | `control.accordion_title_gap` |
| `contentPaddingEnd` | `control.accordion_content_padding_end` |
| `contentEndRatio` | `control.accordion_content_end_ratio` |
| `sizeMedium` | `size.size_medium` |
| `skeletonTextHeight` | `control.skeleton_text_height` |
| `skeletonTextGap` | `control.skeleton_text_gap` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"count":4}` |
| closed | `{"count":4,"open":false}` |
| start | `{"count":4,"align":"start"}` |
| flush | `{"count":4,"isFlush":true}` |
